Name: Cleanup Crew
Author: Androxilogin
Description:
[b][UPDATE] 06/10/21 - [/b]It has been quite a few years since my last update but I've been attempting to get to all of my old content as soon as I could. I meant to get to this last week but unfortunately I ended up losing my best friend of the past 15 years on Saturday. My cat, Kawala. This set me back to a state of emptiness to the point I felt I probably wouldn't even continue my comeback to update all that I once left behind. I ended up forcing myself into it tonight by livestreaming so at least now I can say I've accomplished something. This release is in loving memory of my best friend. Even though it's a simple removal mod, I hope it can bring some sort of enlightenment to anyone who uses it.

Everything has been completely re-written from the ground up. Some inaccessible clutter has not been removed at the moment since it doesn't affect your walking paths. Stumps [b]will not[/b] be removed as previously stated. These have been reserved for the [b]Treelife[/b] mod which will be replaced with growing trees instead. Some things such as "Front" layer issues along the beach are still present. I didn't see any immediate problem with getting the player stuck in the graphics and this mod has been anticipated by many for a long time I figure I can always come back to update the aesthetics of things later. Some clutter on the beach was left which used to work in conjunction with another mod I made, Expanded Crevices, which will be a whole new beast in itself to get up and running again. There is also a possibility of getting stuck in the graphics if you warp from town to the mountain and hold your character down-right to go back to town. I attempted to block this path and failed so far, it looks like I have a little more to learn about this Content Patcher; it's a bit different than ALL. That being said, this mod no longer requires [b]Advanced Location Loader OR Entoarox Framework[/b], just [b]Content Patcher[/b], SMAPI should already be installed if you're using mods in the first place so I don't feel that needs mentioning- even though I just did. 

That being said, I would like to remind everyone to take some time to show their animals at least 15 extra minutes of undivided love and attention. Not just in the game, but your pets outside of it. I am absolutely jealous I don't have the chance to hug mine tonight. Hug yours to the point they're struggling to get away- Elmyra Duff style if need be. 

If you're curious to see how this mod was made,[b] [url=https://www.twitch.tv/videos/1051508711]here is the livestream[/url][/b] of me putting it together for as long as the link lasts.

[b][UPDATE] 01/25/17 - [/b]I honestly don't remember what all was added but this will ensure your game doesn't crash while using this mod! For the absolute latest version and discussion, please visit [url=http://community.playstarbound.com/threads/cleanup-crew.127448/#post-3070278]this thread[/url]. I'm on a limited data plan and Nexus has a lot of ads so even though I try to keep everything here updated as much as possible, I'm a poor fool so sometimes I just have to let it slide by a while. 

[b][UPDATE] 01/18/17 - [/b]New version needs no extra tilesheet because tile fixes (such as the dog fence) are connected to [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/835/?]VIP: Visual Improvement Program[/url] which isn't required by this mod but fixes the dog fence amongst other things. I've been working on and this just seemed like the best way possible. I've retired the Saloon note and replaced it with the debris itself. When you walk up to clutter (where ever) and click on it there will be an option to get rid of it all. [i]Note: This version will override the Town.xnb and Forest.xnb as a quick-fix to some underlying problems beyond my control. This should be resolved in future releases.[/i]

[b][UPDATE] 1/4/17 - Old version was quickly overrun by the new ALL update. This version should fix that. Removed useless lines of code and added some more clutter to remove. Dog fence and shovel at the blacksmith/beside the community center will show pixel errors for the time being.[/b]

[b][UPDATE] 12/14/16 - [/b]BIG changes coming! First of all, stumps will not be cleaned with this mod. I've reverted trees and such to my new [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/784]TreeLife mod[/url]. Other changes will be.. Awesome! I don't want to give anything away so that's all I'm going to say for now!

This mod will clean up the clutter, debris and rocks around Pelican Town. 

[youtube]_VqJb-Zj83E[/youtube]

Special thanks to Entoarox, Pathoschild and all of the other great modders & developers helping me work along. Also my endorsers, donors and Chucklefish forum users, you inspire me to keep coming up with great ideas.

NOT available from stardewmods.com or stardewvalleymods.net
